```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

xml_escape <- function(value) {
  value <- gsub("&", "&amp;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value <- gsub("<", "&lt;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value <- gsub(">", "&gt;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value
}

add_svg_metadata <- function(path, title, description) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  svg_line <- grep("^<svg", lines)[1]
  stopifnot(!is.na(svg_line))
  lines[svg_line] <- sub(
    "<svg ",
    '<svg role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc" ',
    lines[svg_line],
    fixed = TRUE
  )
  metadata <- c(
    sprintf('  <title id="title">%s</title>', xml_escape(title)),
    sprintf('  <desc id="desc">%s</desc>', xml_escape(description))
  )
  lines <- append(lines, metadata, after = svg_line)
  writeLines(lines, path, useBytes = TRUE)
}

make_lonlat_line <- function(lon, lat, crs) {
  sf::st_sf(
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(sf::st_linestring(cbind(lon, lat)), crs = 4326)
  ) |>
    sf::st_transform(crs)
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sf))
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

robinson <- sf::st_crs("+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")

world <- sf::st_as_sf(maps::map("world", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))
world <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_set_crs(world, 4326))
world <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_make_valid(world))
world <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_crop(
  world,
  sf::st_bbox(c(xmin = -179.9, ymin = -89, xmax = 179.9, ymax = 89), crs = sf::st_crs(4326))
))
world <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_transform(world, robinson))

edge_lat <- seq(-89.9, 89.9, length.out = 240)
edge_lon <- seq(-180, 180, length.out = 480)
outline_coordinates <- rbind(
  cbind(edge_lon, rep(-89.9, length(edge_lon))),
  cbind(rep(180, length(edge_lat)), edge_lat),
  cbind(rev(edge_lon), rep(89.9, length(edge_lon))),
  cbind(rep(-180, length(edge_lat)), rev(edge_lat)),
  c(-180, -89.9)
)
outline <- sf::st_sf(
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(sf::st_polygon(list(outline_coordinates)), crs = 4326)
) |>
  sf::st_transform(robinson)

graticule <- sf::st_graticule(
  x = sf::st_bbox(c(xmin = -180, ymin = -89.9, xmax = 180, ymax = 89.9), crs = sf::st_crs(4326)),
  lon = seq(-170, 170, by = 10),
  lat = seq(-80, 80, by = 10),
  ndiscr = 500
)
graticule <- graticule[graticule$degree != 0, ]
graticule$interval <- ifelse(abs(graticule$degree) %% 20 == 0, "20°", "10°")
graticule <- sf::st_transform(graticule, robinson)

equator <- make_lonlat_line(seq(-180, 180, length.out = 720), rep(0, 720), robinson)
greenwich <- make_lonlat_line(rep(0, 360), seq(-89.9, 89.9, length.out = 360), robinson)
antimeridian <- rbind(
  make_lonlat_line(rep(-179.999, 360), seq(-89.9, 89.9, length.out = 360), robinson),
  make_lonlat_line(rep(179.999, 360), seq(-89.9, 89.9, length.out = 360), robinson)
)

reference_labels <- data.frame(
  label = c("Equador · 0°", "Greenwich · 0°", "Antimeridià · 180°", "Antimeridià · 180°"),
  lon = c(-42, 4, -173, 173),
  lat = c(3, -43, -28, -28),
  angle = c(0, 90, 90, 90)
)
reference_labels <- sf::st_as_sf(reference_labels, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  sf::st_transform(robinson)
reference_xy <- cbind(sf::st_drop_geometry(reference_labels), sf::st_coordinates(reference_labels))

points <- data.frame(
  point = LETTERS[1:6],
  lat = c(50, 60, 60, 40, 20, 20),
  lon = c(-120, -140, 170, 140, -160, 160)
)
point_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(points, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  sf::st_transform(robinson)
point_xy <- cbind(sf::st_drop_geometry(point_sf), sf::st_coordinates(point_sf))

stopifnot(
  nrow(point_xy) == 6,
  identical(as.character(point_xy$point), LETTERS[1:6]),
  all(points$lat >= -90 & points$lat <= 90),
  all(points$lon >= -180 & points$lon <= 180)
)

map_theme <- theme_void(base_family = "DejaVu Sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17, color = "#17202a", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 7)),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

make_map <- function(solved = FALSE) {
  map <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = outline, fill = "#eaf3f6", color = "#40515a", linewidth = 0.65) +
    geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#f5f0df", color = "#67747b", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_sf(
      data = graticule[graticule$interval == "10°", ],
      color = "#aebbc1",
      linewidth = 0.22,
      linetype = "22"
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = graticule[graticule$interval == "20°", ],
      color = "#87979f",
      linewidth = 0.32
    ) +
    geom_sf(data = equator, color = "#b64a32", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_sf(data = greenwich, color = "#17697a", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_sf(data = antimeridian, color = "#17697a", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_label(
      data = reference_xy,
      aes(x = X, y = Y, label = label, angle = angle),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      family = "DejaVu Sans",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.25,
      color = "#22313a",
      fill = "#ffffffdf",
      linewidth = 0.2,
      label.padding = grid::unit(1.4, "mm")
    )

  if (solved) {
    map <- map +
      geom_point(
        data = point_xy,
        aes(x = X, y = Y),
        shape = 21,
        size = 6,
        stroke = 1,
        color = "#5e2035",
        fill = "#a63d5a"
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = point_xy,
        aes(x = X, y = Y, label = point),
        family = "DejaVu Sans",
        fontface = "bold",
        size = 4,
        color = "white"
      )
  }

  map +
    coord_sf(crs = robinson, default_crs = robinson, datum = NA, expand = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = if (solved) "Solució: posicions A–F" else "Mapa mut: localitza els punts A–F",
      subtitle = "Reticle de 10° sense numeració; els eixos de referència permeten deduir cada posició"
    ) +
    map_theme
}

exercise_output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/coordinate-systems/geolocation-exercise-world-map.svg")
solution_output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/coordinate-systems/geolocation-exercise-world-map-solved.svg")

svglite::svglite(exercise_output, width = 11.5, height = 6.3, bg = "white")
print(make_map(FALSE))
grDevices::dev.off()
add_svg_metadata(
  exercise_output,
  "Mapa mut per localitzar sis coordenades geogràfiques",
  "Mapamundi en projecció Robinson amb un reticle de deu graus sense valors numèrics. L'equador, el meridià de Greenwich i l'antimeridià estan reforçats i etiquetats per permetre deduir les coordenades dels punts A a F."
)

svglite::svglite(solution_output, width = 11.5, height = 6.3, bg = "white")
print(make_map(TRUE))
grDevices::dev.off()
add_svg_metadata(
  solution_output,
  "Solució de l'exercici de coordenades geogràfiques",
  "El mateix mapamundi situa els punts A a F: quatre a l'oest o a l'est del Pacífic nord i dos propers a l'antimeridià, tots a l'hemisferi nord."
)
```
